output.reason: 71-year-old with fall this morning, severe right hip pain and complete inability to bear weight is a likely hip/femoral neck fracture requiring immediate emergency imaging and orthopedic care, and she cannot safely move or transport herself.
output.patientMessage: Call 911 now. A fall with severe hip pain and being unable to put weight on that leg strongly suggests a broken hip, which needs emergency X-rays and orthopedic care today. Stay still, keep the leg supported, and do not try to walk, stand, or drive yourself. If you feel faint, very cold, or increasingly confused while waiting, tell the dispatcher.
differential: Hip (femoral neck or intertrochanteric) fracture after ground-level fall
Occult hip fracture or pelvic/pubic ramus fracture
